name: Standard Push-ups
instructions: Place hands shoulder-width apart, lower chest until elbow is 90 degrees, push back up.
form_cues: Keep core tight and glutes squeezed; do not let hips sag.
home_alternative: Incline push-ups on wall or bench

name: Knee Push-ups
instructions: Perform push-up movement while resting knees on floor to reduce load.
form_cues: Maintain straight line from knees to head.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with dumbbells, press upwards until arms are extended.
form_cues: Keep upper arms at 45 degree angle to torso to protect shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on incline bench (30-45 deg), press dumbbells up above upper chest.
form_cues: Control the descent and avoid bouncing at the bottom.

name: Barbell Flat Bench Press
instructions: Lie on flat bench, unrack bar, lower to mid-chest, press upward forcefully.
form_cues: Keep feet planted, maintain natural arch in lower back.

name: Dumbbell Chest Flyes
instructions: Lie on bench or floor, open arms wide with slight elbow bend, squeeze chest on return.
form_cues: Do not overstretch shoulders at bottom position.

name: Cable Crossover / Pec Fly
instructions: Stand between cable pulleys, bring handles together in front with a sweeping motion.
form_cues: Focus on chest contraction; keep torso stable.

name: Bodyweight Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, drive through heels to lift hips until aligned with knees.
form_cues: Squeeze glutes hard at the top for 1-2 seconds.

name: Bodyweight Air Squats
instructions: Stand shoulder-width apart, sit back into hips keeping chest up, drive back up.
form_cues: Keep knees tracking over toes; do not cave knees inward.

name: Goblet Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold dumbbell vertically against chest, squat down to parallel, drive up.
form_cues: Keep elbows tucked inside knees and chest proud.

name: Barbell Back Squats
instructions: Position bar on upper traps, squat down below parallel, press up through midfoot.
form_cues: Brace core before each rep; keep spine neutral.

name: Walking Lunges
instructions: Step forward, lower back knee toward ground, push up through front heel to step next.
form_cues: Keep torso upright and front knee behind toes.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
instructions: Hold dumbbells at thighs, hinge at hips pushing glutes back with slight knee bend.
form_cues: Feel stretch in hamstrings; keep back straight and flat.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, grip bar outside legs, lift by driving floor away with legs.
form_cues: Do not round lower back; keep bar close to shins.

name: Standing Calf Raises
instructions: Stand on edge of step or floor, raise heels high as possible, lower slowly.
form_cues: Pause at top for full peak contraction.

name: Leg Press Machine
instructions: Sit in machine, place feet shoulder-width, lower sled, press away without locking knees.
form_cues: Never lock knees out completely at top.

name: Doorframe / Inverted Body Rows
instructions: Grip sturdy doorframe or under table, pull chest toward hands engaging upper back.
form_cues: Retract shoulder blades first before bending elbows.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
instructions: Place one knee/hand on bench or chair, pull dumbbell up to hip pocket with other arm.
form_cues: Lead with elbow; avoid twisting the torso.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge hips to 45 degrees, pull both dumbbells toward waist squeezing lats.
form_cues: Keep neck in neutral alignment with spine.

name: Lat Pulldown Machine
instructions: Grip wide bar, sit upright, pull bar down to collarbone while retracting shoulder blades.
form_cues: Do not lean back excessively; pull with elbows.

name: Pull-ups (Overhand Grip)
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar, pull chest up to the bar leading with chest.
form_cues: Control eccentric lowering; avoid swinging.
home_alternative: Resistance-band assisted pull-up or inverted row

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit with feet braced, pull handle to navel while keeping chest upright and proud.
form_cues: Squeeze shoulder blades together; avoid rounding spine.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie on bench, hold dumbbell with both hands over chest, lower back behind head, pull up.
form_cues: Feel lat stretch; keep slight bend in elbows.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit or stand, press dumbbells from shoulder level upwards until arms lock out overhead.
form_cues: Avoid arching lower back; brace core throughout.

name: Pike Push-ups
instructions: Form inverted V-shape with hips high, lower head toward floor, press back up.
form_cues: Keep hands shoulder-width and look back toward feet.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, raise arms out to side up to shoulder height, lower slowly.
form_cues: Lead with elbows and slight forward tilt; don't swing.

name: Dumbbell Front Raises
instructions: Raise dumbbells in front to shoulder height, lower in controlled manner.
form_cues: Keep torso still; avoid using momentum.

name: Overhead Barbell Military Press
instructions: Stand upright, unrack barbell at shoulders, press vertically overhead.
form_cues: Squeeze glutes and core to protect lower back.

name: Face Pulls (Cable or Band)
instructions: Pull rope attachment toward face, rotating hands back external rotator cuff.
form_cues: Crucial for shoulder posture and rotator cuff health.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls
instructions: Stand upright, curl dumbbells toward shoulders while keeping elbows pinned at sides.
form_cues: Do not swing body; control the downward descent.

name: Hammer Curls (Dumbbells)
instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other (neutral grip), curl to chest level.
form_cues: Builds forearm and brachialis thickness.

name: Barbell EZ-Bar Bicep Curl
instructions: Grip angled EZ bar, curl up while keeping elbows locked in place.
form_cues: Focus on peak bicep contraction at top.

name: Bench / Chair Tricep Dips
instructions: Place hands behind you on bench edge, lower hips bending elbows to 90 deg, press up.
form_cues: Keep back close to the bench; do not shrug shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell with both hands overhead, lower behind neck, extend back up.
form_cues: Keep elbows pointed forward, not flared out wide.

name: Tricep Cable Rope Pushdown
instructions: Attach rope to high pulley, push down extending elbows fully, spread rope at bottom.
form_cues: Keep upper arms locked against ribcage.

name: Parallel Bar Dips
instructions: Support body on dip bars, lower torso with forward lean, press up locking triceps.
form_cues: Control depth to avoid excessive shoulder strain.

name: Plank Hold
instructions: Rest on forearms and toes, keep body in flat straight rigid line, brace abs.
form_cues: Never let lower back sag or butt stick up high.

name: Deadbug
instructions: Lie on back, lower opposite arm and leg while pressing lower back into floor.
form_cues: Ensure lower back never loses contact with the floor.
home_alternative: Bird dog on hands and knees

name: Bicycle Crunches
instructions: Lie on back, bring opposite elbow to knee in alternating cycling motion.
form_cues: Focus on twisting from the torso, not pulling the neck.

name: Hanging Leg Raises
instructions: Hang from bar, raise legs up until perpendicular to torso, lower under control.
form_cues: Avoid swinging; initiate motion by flexing abs.

name: Lying Floor Leg Raises
instructions: Lie flat on back with hands under glutes, lift straight legs to 90 degrees, lower slow.
form_cues: Keep lower back pressed against the floor.

name: Russian Twists
instructions: Sit with knees bent, lean back 45 deg, twist torso side to side touching ground.
form_cues: Keep spine tall and rotate shoulders fully.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on floor with ab wheel, roll forward extending body, pull back using abs.
form_cues: Maintain tight hollow body posture without lower back sag.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Jump feet wide while raising arms overhead, return and repeat rhythmically.
form_cues: Land softly on the balls of your feet.

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: In high plank position, drive knees alternately toward chest in rapid motion.
form_cues: Keep shoulders over wrists and hips level.

name: Burpees
instructions: Drop into squat, kick feet back to plank, perform push-up, jump feet back, leap up.
form_cues: Pace yourself steadily to maintain clean landing form.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Jump with light bounce on toes while turning rope with wrists.
form_cues: Keep elbows tucked in and jump only 1-2 inches high.

name: Dumbbell Thrusters
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulders, squat down deep, explosively stand and press overhead.
form_cues: Use momentum from leg drive to press the weights.
